name: add_to_watchlist
description: Add a stock ticker (e.g., from the Discovery list) to the user's active watchlist. Do NOT use this tool to add items TO discovery; discovery is automatic. Requires user confirmation.

ticker.description: The stock ticker symbol to add (e.g., AAPL).

name: buy_stock
description: Propose a paper buy order for a stock ticker. Supports size_pct (portfolio fraction), quantity (share count), or amount_usd (dollar amount). Sizing and approval are subject to deterministic policy validation.

size_pct.description: The percentage of portfolio equity to target (0.01 to 0.25). Default is 0.10 when quantity/amount_usd are omitted.

quantity.description: Optional number of shares to buy (alternative to size_pct).

amount_usd.description: Optional dollar notional to buy (alternative to size_pct).

name: remove_from_watchlist
description: Remove a stock ticker from the user's active watchlist. Requires user confirmation.

ticker.description: The stock ticker symbol to remove (e.g., AAPL).

name: sell_stock
description: Execute a paper sell order to close or trim a position for a stock ticker. Supports full close (default), quantity (shares), amount_usd (dollars), or size_pct (fraction of holding).

ticker.description: The stock ticker symbol to sell (e.g., AAPL).

quantity.description: Optional number of shares to sell (omit to close full position).

amount_usd.description: Optional dollar notional of shares to sell.

size_pct.description: Optional fraction of the position to sell (0.01 to 1.0).
